title: Atlanta Then and Now Private History Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Must bring own infant seat or child booster seat
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: On this private, guided tour we will dig into Atlanta's history while also looking ahead at where Atlanta is now and where the city is headed. Through exploring some areas such as city centers, historic neighborhoods, a national park, and a cemetery, we'll cover the founding of the city, the destruction of the city during The Civil War, rebuilding during Reconstruction, the Civil Rights movement and beyond. We'll also talk about some of the drivers of Atlanta's current boom. After this tour you'll have a good idea of where Atlanta came from and where it's headed.
